text_block_list.text:
It seemed Mejiro Palmer had gotten 
injured, so I brought her to the infirmary 
just in case.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, Trainer, you're exaggerating so 
much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I'm good, I'm good. I appreciate the 
concern, but I honestly feel like I can 
keep going."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Then how about we just tape it up? 
That'll be plenty enough to run on.
choice_data_list: Let's rest just to be safe after all.
…Let's keep at it just a little longer!
…Wanna keep at it just a little longer?

text_block_list.text:

That'll be plenty enough to run on.
choice_data_list: Let's rest just to be safe after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. Well, they do say carelessness 
is your greatest enemy~ Can't be helped. 
Guess I'll head back and rest."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Still... Ahh, man. What kind of blunder 
did I just pull...?"

Looking thoroughly disappointed, Mejiro 
Palmer headed back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah yeah, that's the spirit! Alright, 
let's head to the track!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, my body's warmed up again. Well, 
I'll take it easy and not push myself too 
hard!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ow ow... Uh-oh. Looks like it really was a 
big deal after all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Sorry Trainer, for making you worry even 
more... Hehehe.

In the end, Mejiro Palmer slumped her 
shoulders, unable to do any training.

And Mejiro Palmer showed us a completely 
carefree, freewheeling run that showed no 
lingering effects of her injury!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... See? Told you there was 
nothing to worry about, right?

Fortunately, the injury turned out to be 
extremely minor. She was able to complete 
the rest of the menu without overexerting 
herself, and training came to an end.
